Every numeric column of the row that reads 'not reported', grouped by reason code (code: columns): no_check = the pair had no pre-selected external outcome check (only the six pairs of Table 2 rows 1-6 had one), so the external-check and regional-colocalization blocks do not exist for it; not_run = the analysis was not run for the pair (ledger word row: not tested); no_row = no ledger row stores this quantity for the pair; the build checks every ledger row whose key or claim names the pair (NOT_CARRIED lists the rows that exist but are not card columns); not_applicable = the quantity is defined for other pairs only (European p of the East Asian-discovered pair; multi-signal PP.H4 of the two kidney loci) or sits in another column for this pair (an East Asian-discovered pair keeps its East Asian colocalization in pp_h4_*; the kidney loci lie outside the 81 map pairs and keep theirs in candidate_*); not_printed = a ledger leaf stores this quantity for the pair, but the manuscript's current Table 2 does not print it, so the shipped card does not carry it (RC1b: the conservative-prior allowance names only values that Table 2 prints)

Ledger rows whose key or claim names the pair (gene and outcome) that no card column uses, grouped by reason code (code: ledger ids): regional_variant = alternative handling of a carried regional-colocalization cell (outcome SNPs with a printed frequency of 0 or 1 dropped, marked descriptive; or beta/SE input, marked sensitivity); Table 3 and the supplement; duplicate = same stored value as a carried leaf (ext_wald_p); asserted equal at build; signal_level = signal-level or multi-signal test or estimate (conditional ratios, heterogeneity, GLS Q, Holm-adjusted p, credible-set size, attribution grid); Results and Table 3, not a per-pair card quantity; ea_outcome_side = East Asian outcome-side estimate of the European instrument; the card holds its state in EAS_state and the ancestry-matched colocalization in the eas_* columns; screen_level = screen- or post hoc-level statistic about the pair (screen counts, East Asian q and heterogeneity p, tied-variant floor, boundary-frequency heterogeneity p); literature_record = literature record; the card holds Table 2's wording (literature_status) and the PMIDs; analysis_inputs = input counts (sample sizes, variants) of the signal analysis; protocol_count = protocol constant or cross-pair count that names the pair among others
